title: Documentation reorganized
description: Added an Atlas overview, explained API updates and Codex-assisted maintenance, and introduced section navigation that follows reading progress. Numbered article sections pair with cards, tables, and collapsible reference details.

title: Methodology and review criteria added
description: Defined inclusion criteria, focus-area assignment, SIIA engagement, and counting rules. Candidate review now shows the same scope checklist. Moved Changelog to the footer.

title: Changelog added
description: Added a dated record of major site and research updates, including earlier milestones.

title: Filtered tables refined
description: Short result lists now fit their content, and empty searches show a clear message within the table.

title: Tracker and Trends expanded
description: Added status and activity filters, companion comparisons, shareable views, and clickable charts. Introduced a cream light theme.

title: Atlas launched
description: Launched a searchable 119th Congress bill tracker, with filters, bill details, and links to public SIIA engagement materials.

title: Trends and chart sharing introduced
description: Added charts covering policy focus areas, introductions, sponsors, and SIIA engagement. Charts can be shared by link or exported as PNG, SVG, or CSV in light or dark mode.

title: Congress.gov connected
description: Matched the original 170 bills to official records and added daily refreshes of titles, sponsors, cosponsors, introduction dates, and latest actions. Kept research summaries and SIIA engagement separate from official updates.

title: Candidate review introduced
description: Expanded discovery to include related topics such as data centers, algorithms, and semiconductors. New candidates enter a separate review queue before being added to the Tracker.
